about: Tokens in the Obligation Hub pages. The installer replaces each {{TOKEN}} in every deploy/pages/*.template.html file with the value for the target site before upload. Values marked 'url', 'guid' or 'path' also appear inside JSON strings, so they must be JSON-safe (no quotes or backslashes).

tokens.meaning: Absolute URL of the Obligation Hub site, no trailing slash.
tokens.encoding: Insert verbatim. Must not contain quotes, < > or whitespace (it appears in HTML attributes and JSON strings).

tokens.meaning: Scheme and host of the site (https://host), no trailing slash. Prefixed to server-relative list URLs.
tokens.encoding: Insert verbatim. Must not contain quotes, < > or whitespace (it appears in HTML attributes and JSON strings).

tokens.meaning: Absolute URL of the folder that holds these .html pages (the SitePages library), no trailing slash.
tokens.encoding: Insert verbatim. Must not contain quotes, < > or whitespace (it appears in HTML attributes and JSON strings).

tokens.meaning: GUID of the Obligations list, without braces. Also used in the live-data manifest key.
tokens.encoding: Insert verbatim, lowercase or uppercase, without braces.

tokens.meaning: GUID of the Contracts document library, without braces. Used in the live-data manifest and the library settings link.
tokens.encoding: Insert verbatim, lowercase or uppercase, without braces.

tokens.meaning: Complete setup prompt for the “Capture new contracts” AI workflow. A site owner pastes it into Copilot in SharePoint on this site to create the workflow; it starts “Create an AI workflow named …”.

tokens.encoding: HTML-escape before inserting (& < > to & < >). It sits inside a <pre> element; line breaks are preserved.
